title: CAD IR Phase 11 — Joint-range self-collision sampling
summary: Implementation plan adding a Tier-5 validator rule that samples N joint poses and checks AABB interference to detect motion-induced part collisions.
notes: Phased build plan in docs/superpowers/plans/.
